'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Pinto LS Yavin 4 (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-yavin4-pre.gif|label=Yavin 4 (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
